candidates.name: Pink Plaid Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The joyful pink is directionally welcome, but the loud plaid, dropped shoulder, oversized long body and novelty accessory styling read streetwear rather than polished Mid-Range Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Textured Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The sky blue is fresh, but the full-resolution source shows an open textured overshirt over a white tee with rolled cuffs and a long rounded hem. It is Casual layering, not a self-contained Formal Evening shirt.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Gingham Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The pale gingham, exposed contrast buttons and untucked casual body look conventional daytime smart-casual rather than current evening polish.

candidates.name: Apricot Checked Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The warm color is useful, but the brown check, open overshirt styling and boxy long body make it a light casual jacket rather than a refined Formal top.

candidates.name: Muted-Blue Utility Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The muted blue helps the palette, but the broad dropped body and two large flap chest pockets create workwear utility volume rather than clean Mid-Range Formal construction.

candidates.name: Purple Utility Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Purple is expressive, but the dropped shoulder, very long boxy body and oversized utility pockets turn it into a shirt-jacket. Color cannot rescue the loose Casual construction.

candidates.name: White Four-Pocket Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Four safari-style pockets, an open collar and beach presentation make this a Resort layer. It lacks the clean front and fabric refinement needed for Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Light-Apricot Mandarin Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The controlled mandarin line is credible, but the near-white linen tone and visibly daytime minimalist finish do not create the requested expressive Spring evening look or prove Mid-Range material quality.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated crop hides rise, seat, full leg and shoe break. Diagonal knee seams and a smooth technical-looking surface prevent it from reading as proven Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Navy Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The very broad navy leg visibly puddles over the shoe. It would make the Spring evening palette dark and bottom-heavy while reproducing the baggy silhouette being removed.

candidates.name: Camel Wide-Leg Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The low casual rise, broad cotton leg and heavy stacking over a chunky sneaker are everyday Casual, not precise Formal Evening tailoring.

candidates.name: Gray Drawstring Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered elastic waist, oversized exposed drawcord, black D-ring and synthetic drape read lounge or technical casual even though the leg is comparatively controlled.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Relaxed Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The original proves an extremely long boxy body, sleeves beyond the wrist, low patch pockets and thin flat fabric. It supplies oversized upper-body volume without the drape, proportion or finish required for Mid-Range Formal Evening.
